caveats.bootstrap: both frozen fits and the realized seasons; player-sampling variability only — not model, not selection, not season uncertainty, and not a forecast interval
caveats.experience_comparison: the experience strata are separate paired samples (different players and class ranges at each experience), so a comparison across experiences is between samples, not a within-person trend; a larger veteran advantage at higher experience is not an automatic 'more NFL information' effect and must be read alongside the per-stratum populations
caveats.role: DG-177's basic cohort trusts the offensive STATLINE position and its weekly snapshot carries historic role disagreements with the roster source (e.g. Jordan Matthews 2014 TE vs WR, Logan Thomas 2014 TE vs QB, N'Keal Harry 2019 TE vs WR, Cordarrelle Patterson 2013 RB vs WR). The audit keeps draft_position and veteran_position as attributes, never joins on position, and counts disagreements; equal targets do not prove historic role integrity. No role repair and no refit in this scope.

rookie_evidence_status_verbatim.inner_menu: retrospective historical evaluation with forecast cutoffs enforced; the policy selects, if at all, only inside each training window, but the policy menu itself was refined after inspecting these historical years, so this is not untouched independent confirmation
rookie_evidence_status_verbatim.plain: exploratory comparison against the declared policy on the same retrospective evaluation; never used to reassign the canonical evidence

caveats.rookie_policy_menu: the rookie producer's policy menu was refined after inspecting the historical years, so its historical evaluation is a retrospective evaluation with forecast cutoffs enforced, not untouched independent confirmation; this audit inherits that caveat for the rookie side
caveats.window: veteran_row_without_window_appearance flags a veteran feature row whose games_t counts stat lines outside the championship window (final regular-season week or postseason) while the window label records no appearance. Those rows are VALID paired evidence — the feature window and the label window differ by design — and are flagged, never rejected.

definitions.experience: feature_season - draft_season + 1 from the draft table; never DG-177 seasons_played (left-censored at 2005)
definitions.not: an audit of two frozen forecasts on one realized target; no correction, blend, uplift, youth bonus, market input, added feature or refit is proposed here
definitions.origins: rookie forecast made at draft time with NFL information through draft_season - 1; veteran forecast made after the feature season with information through it; the gap is the experience in seasons
definitions.position_basis: metrics are grouped by DRAFT position; the veteran role position is retained beside it
definitions.sign_convention: diff = veteran minus rookie; negative favours the veteran forecast
definitions.thin_history: veteran games_t <= 4 in the feature season
